verdicts.reason: A: the 'Build Your Pack' CTA is shrunk to an unreadable pill in the bottom-left. Two of the cans are tiny scraps next to it while one large can sits alone on the far right. The flavour names are split from their descriptors, which then appear in a different order (Bright & zesty under Honey Rosemary's slot). The centre text stack is cramped, with large dead areas on both sides. B has the same scrambled stack of flavour names and descriptors, crammed down to the bottom edge. Its three cans are wildly mismatched in size (one big on the left, two tiny on the right), and the logo floats in the top-right corner. Even so, B keeps a readable, prominent CTA and a larger headline, so it is the less broken of the two.
